data.long_meaning: The name Geraldo is derived from the Germanic name Gerhard, which means 'spear-ruler' or 'brave and strong ruler'. The name Geraldo has been popular in Spain and Portugal, and is of Spanish and Portuguese origin. The name Geraldo carries the meaning “Ruler, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Geraldo usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
